title: Napa and Sonoma Valley Wine 6 hour Tour from San Francisco
blurb: Be whisked away by private vehicle to the Napa and Sonoma valleys on a personalized, 6-hour wine tour. You'll benefit from a customizable itinerary, which makes for an unforgettable excursion in this premier wine region of Northern California, located just 45 miles north of San Francisco. Pricing is per group, based on a maximum of six people; wine tasting fees not included.
